title: dependencies.json
description: Optional declaration of the external assets an entity needs, stored at Entities/<Entity Name>/dependencies.json. Used to make sure referenced packs and assets are loaded and shipped. Deserialized as Sor2NewEra.Gameplay.Dependencies. The file may also contain a literal null, which the editor writes for an entity with no declared dependencies; that is equivalent to the file being absent.

entities.description: Entities from other packs that this entity references, for example a sprite or logic reference entity, or something it spawns.

entityName.description: Entity folder name within that pack.

sounds.description: Sounds from other packs that this entity plays.

soundName.description: Base sound file name without extension.
